items.title: Tesla's new partnership: Swedish company Einride to deploy 500 Tesla semi-truck EVs
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) is partnering with Swedish trucking company Einride (ENRD), which is deploying 500 of Tesla's electric semi-trucks. Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman explains the details.

items.title: What does Tesla's Cybercab launch mean for SpaceX's own ambitions?
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) showcased its new Cybercab — a version of its autonomous robotaxi without a steering wheel — ahead of its planned launch in Austin, Texas. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley and Barron's associate editor Al Root to discuss this story and what it could represent for Elon Musk's ambitions for SpaceX.

items.title: Move Over, Tesla: This Stock Could Be the Real Winner of the Robotaxi Race
items.summary: It's already outpacing Elon Musk's company.

items.title: ‘Highly Conetentious’ Tesla Stock Drops Despite Cybercab Hope
items.summary: The company is preparing to introduce steering wheel-less Cybercab robo-taxis soon, according to The Information, which could be a catalyst for shares.  Tesla investor sentiment remains “highly contentious (as always) with [a] majority of inbound [client calls] tied to  SpaceX  ” wrote Baird analyst Ben Kallo on Tuesday.  Kallo rates Tesla stock Buy and has a $475 price target for shares.

items.title: Tesla Plans Cybercab Launch As Soon As This Month: Report
items.summary: Tesla could begin offering robotaxi rides in Cybercabs by the end of the month, according to The Information. The stock is down 11.5% since last month's earnings call, which showed little progress on robotaxi expansion.

items.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK Bought Nvidia Stock. Here’s What It Sold.
items.summary: Nvidia  stock was slipping early Tuesday amid headwinds for the entire semiconductor sector.  Nvidia shares were down around 2.6% in late-morning trading.  Meanwhile, Wood sold 25,917 shares of AMD across largely the same funds.

items.title: Tesla Lands 500-Truck Order From Einride in World's Largest Tesla Semi Deployment
items.summary: Tesla Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA) has landed an order for 500 Semi electric trucks from Einride AB (NASDAQ:ENRD), in what the Swedish freight company calls the largest Tesla Semi deployment announced to date. The deal comes just months after the first Semi...

items.title: Bezos Quietly Leases 100,000 Square Feet In Oakland For Start-Up That Could Drive “Civilizational Wealth”
items.summary: Jeff Bezos just signed a quiet lease on a massive Oakland warehouse for a secretive AI venture he says will reshape civilizational wealth, and nobody at the company is talking about what gets built inside.
